content.title: Barolo Gianetto
content.subtitle: Barolo DOCG, 2018
content.intro: Barolo from Gianetto, a small named vineyard in Serralunga d’Alba. Ripe dark fruit and spice, made the traditional way.
content.taste_note: A guide, not a measurement of this bottle.
content.window_note: In its window now. Best 2026 to 2036.
content.serve: 61 to 64°F. A little cooler than the room.
content.vintage: 2018 followed a very wet spring with a warm, dry summer. The Nebbiolo is perfumed and silky, lighter than the years around it.
place: Gianetto, a named vineyard in Serralunga d’Alba, facing southeast.
White clay with layers of limestone sand, typical of Serralunga.
Wild yeasts and large Slavonian casks. Bottled unfiltered.
content.credits: Text: critic notes, importer and merchant pages; Barolo vintage reports; the Barolo production rules; CellarTracker. Serving advice is general guidance.
content.decant: One to two hours while it’s young.
